SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.shipping_fee), 2) AS shipping_fees_2025
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: This query adds up the shipping fees on orders marked 'completed' that were placed in 2025, rounded to 2 decimals. It has not been run, so I don't have the total yet. It rests on two assumptions you may want to check: - **What "completed" means:** I filtered on the order status being exactly 'completed'. The schema doesn't list the possible status values, so the real value might be spelled differently, which would change or empty the result. If you meant all orders that count as revenue, the filter should be `is_revenue = true` instead. That may also include statuses like shipped or delivered. - **Which date decides the year:** I used the order date, so an order counts toward 2025 if it was placed in 2025, even if it was completed later.
